results.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang on why he doesn't see an AI bubble bursting anytime soon, says ‘this time it’s different’
results.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang states the AI boom will continue for a long time. He argues this spending reflects a major computing infrastructure shift. Huang believes the industry needs significantly more chips than currently produced. He is not concerned about customer borrowing for AI investments. This fundamental change in computing drives sustained demand for AI technology.
